title: Pointwise a.e. convergence of ergodic averages with respect to two commuting transformations in Lean
summary: This is a Lean 4 formalization of the pointwise a.e. convergence theorem for ergodic averages with respect to two commuting transformations. This theorem was proved by GPT 6 Pro when it was instructed to adapt the recent breakthrough on the triangular Hilbert transform made public by OpenAI. The formalization was generated by Claude Opus 5.5 Medium.
